# drotmg

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Construct the modified Givens rotation of 3 and 4 with both scale factors equal to 1. The leading component is 6.25 and the flag is 1.

## What this example demonstrates

Construct the modified Givens rotation of 3 and 4 with both scale factors equal to 1. The leading component is 6.25 and the flag is 1.
